summary: Full guide/quiz review with real local Kafka/exporter, strict resource and Prometheus rule validation complete.
findings: Corrected supported JMX/StrimziMetricsReporter choices, JMX mapping versus target relabeling, CruiseControl nested configuration rather than CRD.
Replaced archived seglo/kafka-lag-exporter recommendation with Strimzi KafkaExporter1.9.0 automatic internal TLS; actual metric kafka_consumergroup_lag labelconsumergroup.
Added v1 mergepatch preserving baseline, scoped node/exporter PodMonitors and explicitnamespace/cluster/component/role labels, nofalseServiceMonitorunreliability.
Verified final JMX1.6/Kafka4.3.1 rules against isolatedrunningbroker andreal15records; committedoffsetsexportlag3/5/5; allstartedprocessesstopped.
Fixed counter/rate/gauge handling, perclustercontrolleraggregation/duplicateandmissingcases; no splitbrainordatalossclaimfromonecount.
Defined lagasnextoffsetdistancewithcompaction/transaction/businesscommitlimits; negative/missingoffsetsseparatefromzero.
Ninealerts108expectationsacross12scenariosinclallabsent, metricmissing, scrapedown, partialreplication, highlag, unknownoffset, transientandotherclusterisolation.
KEDA2.20.2TLS/SCRAMwithreadonlyKafkaUserandTriggerAuthsameNamespace; aggregateLagThreshold, min1nozero/cooldown andexplicitHPAstabilization; max10within12partitions.
Updated34quizquestionsandversionedKafka/KRaft/Exporter/Connect/CruiseControldashboardreferences; nofigures.
